target.title: Dashboard: ops widgets — agent status + approvals queue
target.body:
> The operational half of the builtin set: see what every agent is doing, and act on what's waiting for you — from a dashboard cell.

Closes #101145 and #101144. **Stacked on #101098** — targets `main` with a cumulative diff; review `agent-status.ts` + `approvals.ts` and their wiring as the delta.

## What's in this PR

**`builtin:agent-status` (#101145)** — a compact per-agent/session status list: active-run vs idle, current label, and freshness — the "what's everything doing right now?" glance. It binds to the same `sessions.list` data the `sessions` builtin already uses (no new backend), so it live-updates on the existing broadcast path.

**`builtin:approvals` (#101144)** — a pending-approvals queue with Approve/Deny actions, wired end-to-end through the **existing** widget-approval infrastructure from #101098 (`dashboard.widget.approve`): pending `custom:` widgets appear as cards, and a decision dispatches the same client path the Workspaces pending-card uses. The queue arrives via a new `ctx.approvals` source on the builtin context (mirroring the existing `ctx.embed` pattern), because it's in-memory workspace state rather than an RPC binding.

**Scope note (deliberate):** the gateway's exec/plugin approval RPCs (`exec.approval.*`, `plugin.approval.*`) exist and the app shell uses them, but they are operator-scoped and not in the dashboard's read-only binding allowlist (`DATA_READ_RPC_ALLOWLIST`). Widening that allowlist is a security decision we didn't want to smuggle into a widget PR — so this widget covers the dashboard's own approval queue today, and is shaped to take exec/plugin approvals as additional sources the moment maintainers bless that allowlist addition (called out in the module header). That keeps #72545 progressing without expanding any privilege surface.

## How it works
Both widgets follow the established builtin contract (`renderX(widget, value, ctx) => TemplateResult`), registered in `BUILTIN_WIDGET_RENDERERS` + `BUILTIN_KIND_PATTERN`. Agent-status is a pure mapper over the resolved `sessions.list` value. Approvals renders from `ctx.approvals` (built by the dashboard view from workspace state) and dispatches decisions through the existing, already-authorized `dashboard.widget.approve` method — this PR adds **no new gateway method and no new privilege**.

No new dependency — `pnpm-lock.yaml` unchanged.

## Real behavior proof
**Behavior or issue addressed:** There's no cross-agent activity view in the dashboard (#101145 / the #39127–#54577 cluster), and approvals had no dashboard surface (#101144, advancing #72545) — operators had to open each session or wait for the pending-card to appear on the Workspaces tab. This adds two operational builtins: a live agent-status list and an approvals queue with working Approve/Deny.
**Evidence:** `pnpm vitest run src/lib/dashboard` → 100 passed, including the new suites (status derivation filters + provenance, decision-vocabulary mapping + limit, populated/empty renders, and Approve/Deny wiring asserted against a mocked client dispatching `dashboard.widget.approve`); `pnpm ui:i18n:check` clean; `pnpm ui:build` and full type-aware oxlint clean; `node scripts/test-projects.mjs extensions/dashboard` green (schema kind additions).
